description:
Collect inventory data and metrics of your hosts and sends it to the New Relic platform.


What's Changed
🛡️ Security notices
- Bump Go to 1.27.4 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2410
- Bump embedded OHI versions (nri-docker v2.10.1, nri-flex v1.18.19, nri-winservices v1.5.8, nri-prometheus v2.31.1) in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2411
🚀 Enhancements
- Add support for SUSE 16 OS in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2381
- Expose nrjmx wrapper scripts in the Agent Control package and agent types in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2367
🐞 Bug fixes
- canary pruning to support multiple regions (staging/EU/JP) in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2348
- Add the rpm ndb database file so the rpm plugin works on SLES 16.0 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2406
- reading the sshd config from /usr/etc/ssh when /etc/ssh/sshd_config is missing on SLES 16 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2407
- Add the agent to its Windows Job Object by using OpenProcess in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2409
Full Changelog: https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/compare/2.0.2...2.1.1
